run_preprocess_map: run the preprocess_map.py script to regenerate preprocessed Boost.MPL map header files for plain and typeof_based modes
review_preprocess_main_call: review the preprocess.main invocation that processes map auxiliary headers into the preprocessed output directory
refactor_preprocess_map_modes: refactor preprocess_map.py to accept command-line arguments instead of hardcoded mode and directory values
summarize_preprocess_map_script: summarize the preprocess_map.py script which delegates to preprocess.main for Boost.MPL map header pre-processing
test_preprocess_map_execution: test running preprocess_map.py to verify it correctly invokes preprocess.main with the plain and typeof_based modes
